title: intent-fusion-admin-slate: context-aware tasklet composer and auto-triage
creator: Avery Kim
description:
Goal: build 'Admin Slate' — a lightweight, context-aware operator surface that composes runbook fragments (tasklets) from intent signals and telemetry, exposes a dry-run/simulate mode, enforces RBAC/audit gates, and provides a predictable execution pathway for common incident remediation. This ticket covers the end-to-end MVP: intent parsing -> candidate tasklet ranking -> typed parameter generation -> safe execution plan -> telemetry signals -> immutable execution record.

Why now: incidents remain high-touch; first-line responders spend time translating high-level intent into exact admin commands. The Slate reduces cognitive load, standardizes remediation, and makes actions replayable and auditable.

Key capabilities (MVP):
- Natural-intent capture: short free-text or structured form from Console/CLI/Slack and automatic context attachment (recent traces, alerts, runbook matches).
- Tasklet composition: assemble short, typed runbook fragments (idempotent steps) with validated parameters and suggested defaults inferred from context.
- Safe preview & dry-run: deterministic simulator that validates side-effects and surface potential risk with a simple risk score.
- Controlled execution: RBAC and canary execution policies; require step confirmations for high-risk actions.
- Telemetry & rollback hooks: tie each runlet to traces, logs, cost delta, and automatic rollback playbooks when signals cross thresholds.
- Audit & provenance: immutable execution record + link to PRs/docs/telemetry dashboards.

Architecture notes / decisions: hybrid approach selected — intent-first for UX, but tasklets encoded as small typed stubs (JSON-like) to avoid the brittleness of full DSLs. We will NOT ship a Turing-complete DSL in MVP to minimize surface area for abuse. The backend service will be two components: "slate-api" (intent handling, tasklet assembly, gating) and "slate-exec" (execution engine that calls existing operator helpers and orchestration APIs with strict permission checks).

Trade-offs considered:
- Full DSL vs typed tasklets: typed tasklets chosen to simplify validation and UXR.
- Heavyweight simulation vs heuristic risk flags: MVP uses deterministic dry-run for a subset of step types and heuristic flags for the rest to ship quicker.
- Centralized vs distributed policy: start centralized policy store to simplify rollouts; plan for a distributed policy cache in follow-ups.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console flow for composing an intent and receiving top-3 suggested tasklets with typed params.
- Dry-run available for at least 5 core remediation patterns (k8s-roll/pod-restart/scale/db-migration-toggle/feature-flag-reset).
- Execution gated by RBAC and emits audit record to the platform audit-log.
- End-to-end test harness simulates an incident and validates rollback on failure.
- Latency SLO for suggestion endpoint: median < 350ms in staging under synthetic traffic.

Observability & metrics: suggestion latency, success/failure rate of executions, percent of suggested tasklets accepted by oncall, average time-to-remediate when using Slate vs manual baseline. Dashboard prototype: /dashboards/operator-slate (linked in links).

Security controls: param whitelisting, secret redaction, KMS-integrated key usage for any credential ops, and mandatory security review before production rollout.

Out-of-scope for MVP: full policy-as-code, multi-tenant private deployments, advanced natural language refinements (deferred to follow-up).

2026-02-20: PoC intent parser implemented (lightweight regex + model fallback) — repo: github.com/redwood-inference/slate-poc PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slate/pull/12. Initial tests show 82% correct param extraction on curated prompt set.

2026-02-27: Security sync — decided to require security_review_required=true and KMS gating for any execution that touches secrets or customer data. Security requested an audit checklist (assigned to Rohan Patel).

2026-03-03: Backend skeleton merged: slate-api routes and exec stub (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slate/pull/34). Added feature flag slate.mvp.enabled. Performance note: suggestion endpoint 95th=1.1s under dev workload; need optimization (see tasks below).

2026-03-05: Design review — Console modal mock uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SlateMocks. Design feedback: inline explainers for risk score; confirm default 'dry-run' toggled on for non-sre users.

2026-03-08: Integration plan with runbook catalog: will surface candidate fragments from runbook-index service and fallback to heuristic templates. Dependency ticket ENG-314159 assigned for runbook-index adaptation.

2026-03-10: Current status: core API routes implemented, dry-run simulator prototype working for k8s actions, outstanding work: permission gating, telemetry bindings, suggestion latency optimization (investigate caching + async scoring).
